titre: Pass'Sport: a discount on sports club membership
resume: €50 off membership of a sports club for 2026-2027, to be used before December 31, 2026: who is eligible, how to get the code and what to bring to the club.
aQuoiCaSert: The Pass'Sport (a government sports grant for young people) reduces the cost of enrolling your child in a partner club, association or gym. The €50 discount is applied directly by the club to the license or membership. If enrollment costs less than €50, the club undertakes to give the young person the benefit of the difference, for example in equipment.
quiEstConcerne: Young people aged 6 to 17 (inclusive) whose beneficiary household has a Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) or MSA (Mutualité sociale agricole, the farmers' social security fund) family quotient of €699 or less.
Young people aged 6 to 19 (inclusive) receiving the AEEH (disabled child education allowance), and those aged 16 to 30 (inclusive) receiving the AAH (adult disability allowance).
Students on grants up to age 28 inclusive (grant from the Crous, the student services agency, or regional grant for health and social care training, awarded before October 15, 2026).
aSavoir: Amount for 2026-2027: €50 per young person, compared with €70 in 2025-2026.
Can be used for enrollments made between September 1 and December 31, 2026.
Codes were emailed between September 9 and 13, 2026, to the address known to the Caf, the MSA or the Crous, with a separate email for each eligible minor child. Also check your spam folder.
No email? Check eligibility on the official website, then apply online (preferably with FranceConnect, the government login service). The code arrives by email within up to 72 hours.
The Pass'Sport is accepted by more than 85,000 organizations in France. A club is not required to join the scheme; a club missing from the indicative list may still accept it.

Separated parents: eligibility depends on the family quotient of the beneficiary household. The code is therefore sent to the address of the parent who receives the benefits: pass it on if the other parent is enrolling the child.

An additional Caf grant for sports equipment has been announced for the 1st quarter of 2027 for beneficiaries aged 6 to 17 who activated their Pass'Sport at the start of the 2026 school year. Its amount has not been specified.
